source: MASSIVE 1.1 pt-PT, allowed train/development; reserved workers and original test withheld
hypothesis: A small hashed representation of adjacent word pairs and local three-word windows, trained jointly with existing character features, can improve intent and BIO span composition on unseen public language without adding an external model or labels at inference.
representation: AXSQ0014 is emitted only for split-head lexical encoders with character buckets. It adds bounded start/end-aware bigram and trigram feature rows into the existing hashed character page; old codecs and old headers remain readable. The feature page is immutable during inference.
controls: Policy 0 is the frozen split-head control. Policies 1 and 2 change only the character bucket count and activate AXSQ0014. All policies share seed, corpus, epochs, optimizer, dropout, regions and hidden width. Development selects the winner; reserved workers and original test remain untouched until a separate audit.
scope: Diagnostic M1 experiment only. It cannot certify M1 or permit M2 unless every required gate is independently re-run under evals/protocols/m1-completion-v1.json.
